scientific_integrity: Statements are presented as proved by transparent combinatorial arguments and exact rational finite certificates. Direct finite tests are corroborative and no independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The exact finite symbolic proof applies to matching-deleted balanced complete bipartite graphs with the specified tie retention; it does not give attraction-basin counts or the effect of deleting other matchings. The classical 1980 paper was not inspected in full; historical-priority uncertainty remains.
title: Parity-controlled recurrent orbit counts for synchronous majority on crown graphs
